title: 第14章 八块，不是六块，请修改-《穿越2006小手替被影帝追着宠》
content:
第(1/3)页

    “小汐！”

    “我没事，谢谢。”韩小汐勉强站稳，“小感冒。”

    沈轩看着她红得不正常的脸蛋，伸手探了探她的额头，“你发烧了。需要去医院。”

    “嗯嗯。”韩小汐没太在意，感冒多喝水就行。

    片场助理在喊沈轩上戏，沈轩没辙，只得先过去，“别硬撑着，该请假请假。”

    韩小汐很感激的点头，请假什么的还是算了，日薪三百呢！

    她继续缩到休息区，灌了一大杯热水。

    还是好难受。

    好在今天事情不多，她可以摸一会儿鱼。

    正在难受的时候，郭炜拎着一个手提袋过来。

    “韩小姐，老板让我送来的。”郭炜没有避讳人，“说是你落在他那里的。”

    “好的好的，帮我谢谢沈老师。”韩小汐可太谢谢了，不用见到当事人就行，管他有没有看到里面的内容呢！

    郭炜多看了韩小汐两眼，才离开。

    人一走，韩小汐连忙翻起了手提袋。

    额，居然是她的大红围巾和眼镜。

    特么居然没有手账本！

    韩小汐赌气地将大红围巾裹在了脖子上，太冷了。

    黑框眼镜也架在了鼻梁上，挡黑眼圈。

    这男人耍她呢！

    ……

    保姆车上，沈珩看着手里的手账本，眉头拧成了结。

    大炜办的这叫什么事？

    最重要的东西居然漏了……

    他随意夹着手账本，起身，下车。

    迎头遇上郭炜，“老板，送过去了。”

    “那我手里的是什么？”

    郭炜：……。

    “我再跑一趟。”郭炜弄了一个大红脸。

    “不用。”沈珩已经抬脚离开。

    郭炜想立马跟上，被斯蒂芬拉住了胳膊。

    “你去凑什么热闹？！”

    ……

    韩小汐原本以为自己能硬扛的。

    毕竟连三年疫情都扛过来了。

    可没想到越来越难受，比刚刚在片场还晕。

    不想硬撑了，好歹吃个药睡一觉。

    大家都在忙，尤其是于导，韩小汐准备去找道具组长请假。

    虽然那位王哥很不待见她，酸她是常有的事。

    但她也没在意过，她毕竟只是在道具组挂名。

    只是刚站起身，就一阵眩晕。
    第(1/3)页

"Xiao tide!"

"I'm fine, thank you." Han Xiaoxi barely stood still, "I have a little cold."

Shen Xuan looked at her abnormally red face and reached out to touch her forehead, "You have a fever. You need to go to the hospital."

"Hmm." Han Xiaoxi didn't pay much attention. Just drink more water if you have a cold.

The assistant on the set was calling Shen Xuan to come on stage, but Shen Xuan had no choice but to go over first, "Don't hold on, it's time to ask for leave."

Han Xiaoxi nodded gratefully, forget about asking for leave, the daily salary is three hundred!

She continued to shrink into the rest area and drank a large glass of hot water.

It still feels so uncomfortable.

Fortunately, there wasn’t much going on today, so she could fish for a while.

When he was feeling uncomfortable, Guo Wei came over carrying a handbag.

"Ms. Han, the boss asked me to deliver it." Guo Wei did not shy away from anyone, "I said you left it with him."

"Okay, okay, thank Teacher Shen for me." Thank you so much, Han Xiaoxi. You don't need to see the person involved, regardless of whether he has seen the content!

Guo Wei looked at Han Xiaoxi twice before leaving.

As soon as the person left, Han Xiaoxi quickly opened her handbag.

“Well, it’s actually her red scarf and glasses.

Why don’t you have a ledger!

Han Xiaoxi wrapped the red scarf around her neck angrily. It was too cold.

Black-rimmed glasses are also placed on the bridge of the nose to block dark circles under the eyes.

This man is playing tricks on her!

……

In the nanny’s car, Shen Heng looked at the ledger in his hand, his brows knitted into knots.

What is the name of what Da Wei did?

The most important thing is actually missing...

He casually folded his account book, got up, and got out of the car.

Meeting Guo Wei head-on, "Boss, send it over."

"Then what's in my hand?"

Guo Wei:…….

"I'll make another trip." Guo Wei blushed.

"No need." Shen Heng had already raised his feet and left.

Guo Wei wanted to follow immediately, but Stephen grabbed his arm.

"Why are you joining in the fun?!"

……

Han Xiaoxi originally thought she could handle it.

After all, we have survived three years of epidemics.

“I didn’t expect that it would become more and more uncomfortable. I was even more dizzy than I was just on the set.

I don’t want to hold on any longer, so I’ll take some medicine and sleep.

Everyone is busy, especially Director Yu, and Han Xiaoxi is going to ask for leave from the props team leader.

Although Brother Wang didn’t like her very much, it was common for him to be angry with her.

But she never cared about it. After all, she was just a member of the props team.

As soon as I stood up, I felt dizzy.
